title: Batch-Size Credit in Missing-Items Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Large batches leave more room for an item to go astray, and a missing-items dispute on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts carries a batch-size credit sized by the item units on the disputed violation's batch.

**Which batch.** The disputed violation's batch is the batch named on the missing-items violation entry under dispute; its item units are read from that batch's record in Cartwise Shopper Batches.

**Clause.** 80 or more item units give a batch-size credit of 2 points; from 40 up to 79 item units (one fewer than 80) give 1 point; fewer give no credit.

| Item units on the disputed violation's batch | Batch-size credit |
|---|---|
| 80 or more | 2 points |
| 40 to 79 | 1 point |
| 0 to 39 | None |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical batches)

| Item units | Credit |
|---|---|
| 80 | 2 points |
| 79 | 1 point |
| 40 | 1 point |
| 39 | None |

A hypothetical Stock-Up Batch carrying 112 item units gives 2 points on this schedule; a Single Delivery Batch of 18 units gives none.
